timing_scope.loop: fixed-60Hz host release paced file incl verification; no GUI
timing_scope.frame_work_ms: sum of host-measured stage wall times; NOT latency
timing_scope.submit_to_pose_completion_ms: host detector submit to pose end
timing_scope.pose_inference_ms: sum of native pose-call wall times; one batch2 call covers two same-frame slots
timing_scope.pose_stage_ms: elapsed wall time for ALL people in frame
timing_scope.pose_queue_ms: submit to pose body; includes selected dependency
timing_scope.pose_dependency_wait_ms: pose worker waits for admitted detector
timing_scope.pose_submit_gap_ms: prior pose completion to next submission; N-1

detector.preflight_source: synthetic zero tensor; not measured tracking

pose.preflight_source: synthetic zero tensor; not measured tracking

1.preflight_source: synthetic zero tensor; not measured tracking

2.preflight_source: synthetic batch2 zero tensor; not measured tracking

same_frame_batching.routing: adjacent same-frame pairs; unpadded single remainder

host_process_cost.scope: measured loop, all host process threads; setup excluded

replay_ages.scope: fixed-60Hz scheduled file release to validation complete; not photon latency
replay_ages.workload_scope: ending frame; backlog may originate in earlier frames

pose_count_timing_semantics.frame_pose_ms: sum of native pose-call wall times; batch2 call covers two detector slots
pose_count_timing_semantics.per_person_ms: batch1 duration; batch2 duration divided equally for accounting only
pose_count_timing_semantics.elapsed_pose_stage_ms: elapsed wall time for all people in frame
pose_count_timing_semantics.elapsed_detector_stage_ms: elapsed detection wall time in same frame

pose_count_timing_semantics.frame_pose_ms: sum of native pose-call wall times; batch2 call covers two detector slots
pose_count_timing_semantics.per_person_ms: batch1 duration; batch2 duration divided equally for accounting only
pose_count_timing_semantics.elapsed_pose_stage_ms: elapsed wall time for all people in frame
pose_count_timing_semantics.elapsed_detector_stage_ms: elapsed detection wall time in same frame

output_cadence.scope: host validation completions grouped by ORIGINAL source PTS; input release is fixed 60Hz
output_cadence.window_rate_definition: (completions-1) / host first-to-last span in source bin
output_cadence.window_edge_intervals: excluded within bins; included in global intervals
output_cadence.person_count_attribution: ending frame workload; not isolated inference cost
output_cadence.interval_budget_note: Original PTS are preserved for identity/reporting but do not drive this arm's release. Inspect replay source-age and fixed-rate pacer summary for backlog.

per_frame_detector_boxes.scope: ordered detector-slot float32 edges; not actor correspondence

per_frame_predictions.scope: all slots, scores, validity and PTS; bitwise, not actor accuracy

provider_disagreement.reference: same-provider first completed arm; NOT truth
